about: The old (8.x hand) bindings' SubD control net, per fixture: each edge's ControlNetPoint(0/1), ControlNetDirection and VertexId(0/1); each face's ControlNetPoint(i). Frozen at the switch-over (M3, 2026-10-31); the oracle of test_retired_subd_control_net_g3_and_table_moves (triage G3). A point is [x, y, z], "nan" for an unset coordinate.
